name: safari
title: Safari Browser Mockup
blurb: Safari browser mockup frame displays content with default or simple mode.
description: A browser mockup frame styled as Safari with URL bar and browser chrome. Displays images or autoplay video with configurable appearance modes (default or simple).
use_when: Landing pages, product showcases, design portfolios, or marketing displaying web content in Safari context.
avoid_when: When actual browser functionality is needed; this is a static decorative mockup frame only.
a11y: Browser frame is decorative; content accessibility depends on media alt attributes or children components.
